description: Withdraw the user's own open candidacy: a mission they offered to take or a resource they offered to bring (a row of listMyApplicationsTool). It is archived, never deleted; its silence clock stops, the rikma's members are told in one line, and the opening stays open so the user can apply again later. Only the candidate can withdraw - never anyone else's proposal. BEFORE calling, name the mission or resource and the rikma to the user and get their yes - then pass confirmedWithUser: true. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#withdrawCandidacyTool

confirmedWithUser.description: true only after the user heard which candidacy and rikma it is and said to withdraw it.
